$comment: Data for tools/sync-community.mjs, by repository directory name. Defaults: docs https://developer.kition.ai (docsName "Kition for Developers"), developerLink true, quality true (the repository has AGENTS.md and docs/quality.md, and its check command comes from templates/quality/repositories.json, else cargo xtask ci; with quality false, give check here), changelog true, keep []. Kits also default to hasWeb true, linksTessera true (KITION_LINK=1 links kition-sdk and kition-tessera; false: kition-sdk only), fonts false (pnpm engine copies fonts from a kition-fonts checkout), uses [rust, wasm32, wasm-pack, node, pnpm], the scope rows and the build commands below under kitDefaults. keep lists generated paths the repository owns itself (a trailing /* keeps a directory). Markdown links in the data are relative to the repository root; the tool rewrites them for the files in .github/.

scope: The engine (Rust), compiled to WebAssembly for the editor
The headless kit executable for Kition's agent
The repository's tasks: `cargo xtask ci`, the check every change passes, and the others
build: cd web && pnpm install && pnpm engine && pnpm test:flow

kition-fonts.title: Kition Fonts
kition-fonts.description: The fonts that Kition's kit editors serve to their engines at run time.
scope: The font files, each with its license file, and `fonts/manifest.txt`
The checks on every file: checksum, license, family name, and script coverage
rules: - **Only open licenses whose terms the source proves** (Apache-2.0, OFL-1.1, or MIT), nothing from Adobe or derived from Adobe's designs, and for every file a manifest line, its license file, and an attribution row ([README.md](README.md)).
kition-fonts.licenseNote: Each font keeps its own license, named in `fonts/manifest.txt`.

kiv.title: kiv
kiv.description: kiv (KIt Version) is Git for kit files.
scope: The `kiv` command: object-level diffs, merges through the kit, and the merge queue
The demo builder and the end-to-end tests
build: cargo test --release           # alignment, diff, and merge-plan tests
kiv.notes: The build fetches kition-sdk's `kition-kit-host` from GitHub at the revision `Cargo.toml` pins. The end-to-end tests (`scripts/e2e.sh`) need the slide kit's headless executable, `kition-slide`.

kitharness.org.title: kitharness.org
kitharness.org.description: The site of the Kit Harness Protocol (KHP): a neutral protocol site, not a product site.
scope: The pages: overview and guides in English and Simplified Chinese (`zh-cn/`), and the specification under `spec/`
The kitharness and benchmark commits the specification and the benchmark figures come from
Syncing the specification, exporting the benchmark figures, checking links, drawing the OG image
build: npm run build                  # dist/, with sitemap, canonical URLs and OG tags
node scripts/check-links.mjs   # internal links and anchors in dist/
rules: - **Never edit `src/content/docs/spec/` by hand.** Change the specification in the kitharness repository (`kitharness/kitharness`), commit, and copy it with `node scripts/sync-spec.mjs`.
- **Every statement is true at the time of the build**, and there is no Kition branding beyond the footer's "Reference implementation" link.
